mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'OVERTIME' AND type = 'TO_LEAVE' AND status = 'APPROVED' THEN hours WHEN kind = 'LEAVE' AND type = 'COMPENSATORY' AND status IN ('APPROVING', 'APPROVED') THEN -hours ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM hr_leave WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT COALESCE(d.name, '-')COALESCE(dd.dict_label, l.type, '-') AS group_name, COUNT(*) AS apply_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.employee_id) AS employee_count, SUM(l.hours) AS hours FROM hr_leave l
LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = l.dept_id
LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = CASE WHEN l.kind = 'OVERTIME' THEN 'hr_overtime_comp' ELSE 'hr_leave_type' END AND dd.dict_value = l.type AND dd.tenant_id = #{dictTenant}
WHERE l.kind = #{kind} AND l.status = 'APPROVED' AND l.start_time >= #{from} AND l.start_time < #{to} GROUP BY l.dept_id, d.namel.type, dd.dict_label ORDER BY SUM(l.hours) DESC
